description: This file defines a command handler class for deleting financial activity account mappings within the Fineract accounting module. It is annotated as a Spring service and handles deletion commands by invoking the write platform service.

classes.name: DeleteFinancialActivityAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service implementing command handling for deleting financial activity account mappings, relying on dependency injection for the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete method on the write platform service with the entity ID and command.
